+              gripper_right: float = 0.07) -> np.ndarray:
+    """Map trunk/left/right IK joint order into the 25-column action layout."""
+    row = np.zeros(25, dtype=float)
+    row[3:7] = q[:4]
+    row[7:14] = q[4:11]
+    row[14:16] = gripper_left
+    row[16:23] = q[11:18]
+    row[23:25] = gripper_right
+    return row
+
+
+def move_eef(robot: Robot, side: str, pose: np.ndarray, *, close_left: bool = False,
+             rows: int = 24) -> dict:
+    """Solve one end-effector pose from current proprioception, then stream joints."""
+    obs = robot.get_obs()
+    now = np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
+    seed, base = named_ik_state(robot, now)
+    answer = robot.ik({f"{side}_eef_link": pose.tolist()}, seed=seed.tolist(),
+                      base_pose=base.tolist(), max_iters=300)
+    print("IK", side, answer.get("ok"), answer.get("error"))
+    if not answer.get("ok"):
+        return {"ik": answer, "moved": False}
+    goal = np.asarray(answer["q"], dtype=float)
+    gl = 0.0 if close_left else float(now[24])
+    gr = float(now[26])
+    actions = np.stack([
+        joint_row((1 - t) * seed + t * goal, gl, gr)
+        for t in np.linspace(0, 1, rows)
+    ])
